title: Retractable hooks and garment rod 10-Inch Wall Mount Solid Brass, Fresno Collection, modern bath accessory Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade tight spaces with a retractable hooks and garment rod that pulls out for hanging garments or towels and retracts neatly when not in use. Designed for wall-mount installation in an end wall or door frame with concealed screw hardware, it complements the Fresno collection for a clean, architectural look.

Highlights:
- Retractable pullout garment rod for laundry area, dressing area, or bathroom use
- Wall mount design helps keep spaces open and organized (space-saving)
- Solid brass construction
- Matches Fresno collection pieces for matching Fresno, modern bath accessories, and contemporary bath accessories
- Offered in a wide variety of designer lifetime finishes including statement colors

Specs:
- Rod length / projection: 10-Inch
- Overall size: 10-Inch L x 2-Inch W x 1.9-Inch H
- Weight capacity: 10 lb
- Installation: End wall or door frame; concealed screw mounting
- Included: Brass rod, rod housing, and all installation hardware
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
Note: Requires 10 inches of wall depth to retract.

_previous.title: Fresno Collection Retractable Pullout Garment Rod
_previous.description: Enjoy the convenience of this pull out garment rod in many places around your home. Rod installs in an end wall or door frame and retracts when not in use. When the rod is extended it provides a handy place to hang your garments or towels. Great in a laundry area, dressing area or in the bathroom. Garment rod requires 10 inches of wall depth to retract. Crafted of the finest solid brass materials and provided with one of our designer lifetime finishes.
